## NVSU_Student_Survey

The 'NVSU_Student_Survey' data set is a data frame with 68 rows and 2 variables.

- 'Living_Arrangement' With_Family, Independent_Living.

- 'Academic_Satisfaction' Low_satisfaction, Moderate_Satisfaction, High_Satisfaction.

This data set provides information on student profiles at Nueva Vizcaya State University (NVSU), summarized according to living arrangements and academic satisfaction.

The first 6 rows of the data set are shown in @tbl-satisfaction

- `internet_source`: Fixed Wi-Fi / Broadband / Campus Wi-Fi, Mobile Data / Cellular.

## Descriptive Statistics

The summary statistics of study_hours_num when grouped according to internet_source are shown in @tbl-summary.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Summary statistics of study hours grouped by internet source."
#| message: false

df |> 
  tbl_summary(
    by = internet_source,
    include = study_hours_num,
    statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})"),
    label = list(study_hours_num ~ "Estimated Study Hours")
  ) |>
  add_overall()
```

# Hypothesis Testing

### Research Question

Do students using fixed broadband versus mobile data differ significantly in their estimated weekly study hours?

```{r}
#| label: tbl-shapiro
#| tbl-cap: Shapiro-Wilk normality test.

df_fixed <- df |>
  filter(internet_source == "Fixed Wi-Fi / Broadband / Campus Wi-Fi") |>
  select(study_hours_num)

shapiro_fixed <- shapiro.test(df_fixed$study_hours_num) |>
  tidy() |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))

df_mobile <- df |>
  filter(internet_source == "Mobile Data / Cellular") |>
  select(study_hours_num)

shapiro_mobile <- shapiro.test(df_mobile$study_hours_num) |>
  tidy() |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))

bind_rows(shapiro_fixed, shapiro_mobile) |>
  mutate(
    internet_source_group = c("Fixed Wi-Fi / Broadband", "Mobile Data / Cellular")
  ) |>
  relocate(internet_source_group, .before = 1) |>
  kable()
```

### Results and Interpretation

The plot and test statistics is shown on @fig-stats.

```{r}
#| label: fig-stats
#| fig-cap: Comparison of study hours by internet source.
#| fig-height: 3

ggbetweenstats(
  data = df,
  x = internet_source,
  y = study_hours_num,
  type = "nonparametric",
  bf.message = FALSE,
  xlab = "Internet Source",
  ylab = "Estimated Weekly Study Hours"
)
```

Based on the plot and the *p*-value being greater than 5% (*p*-value = .060), we fail to reject the null hypothesis. There is insufficient evidence that the mean estimated weekly study hours are different when grouped according to internet source. Students using fixed broadband connections and those using mobile data tend to report comparable weekly study hours. Thus, primary internet source does not significantly alter weekly study commitment in this sample.
